actions.action: Scratch-test several stems and branch tips for green tissue
Check soil moisture 2 inches down under the gravel
Prune clearly dead wood back to green tissue
Water deeply at the base about weekly when soil is dry
Pull gravel back from the crown and add 2-3 inches of pine bark or shredded wood mulch
